reason: Our trouble is the water as much as the power. Some days the tap gives nothing, and a battery does not fill the tub, so we will keep washing by hand. Twenty-two thousand is close to a full month of our earnings, and nobody in the family or the lane has one of these yet.
objection: Water supply is not reliable, so a machine does not help much. On days with no water it is just an expensive box, and I have not heard from any relative that this battery thing really works.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour had one running for a few months and told me it works even with our water problems, and the dealer I trust stood behind it, I would think about it on EMI.
